# Alpha Douro — Intimate Luxury Boat Tours in Porto & the Douro River

> Alpha Douro is a boutique, human-scale boat tour operator departing from Douro Marina (Pontoon A / Pontão A, R. da Praia 430, Afurada, Vila Nova de Gaia — Porto, Portugal). Alpha Douro welcomes a maximum of **10 guests** per voyage for an unhurried, quiet-luxury 2-hour crossing defined by **The 10 Engine-Off Minutes** and **Numbered Voyages**.

## Core Positioning
- **Maximum Capacity:** 10 guests (intimate, unhurried hospitality).
- **Duration:** 2 hours on every standard voyage.
- **Included on Every Tour:** Curated Douro wine tasting on board + The 10 Engine-Off Minutes ritual + numbered Digital VIP Boarding Pass + warm Portuguese wool throws + free weather rescheduling or 100% refund.
- **Winter Schedule (October – March · 3 Departures/Day):** 11:00–13:00 (7 Bridges · €30) · 13:30–15:30 (7 Bridges · €30) · 15:45–Sunset (Sunset & Ocean · €60).
- **Summer Schedule (April – September · 4 Departures/Day):** 11:00–13:00 (7 Bridges · €30) · 14:00–16:00 (7 Bridges · €30) · 16:30–18:30 (7 Bridges Late Afternoon Light · €30) · 19:00–Sunset (Sunset & Ocean · €60).
- **Operating Hours:** Daily 08:00–22:00. Boarding 10 minutes before departure at Pontoon A.
- **Departure Point:** Douro Marina · Pontoon A (Pontão A), R. da Praia 430, 4400-554 Afurada, Vila Nova de Gaia, Porto, Portugal (GPS: 41.1409959, -8.6512348). Free parking 30 meters from the pier.
- **Direct Booking (0% Commission):** https://alphadouro.com/ | English: https://alphadouro.com/en/ | Sunset: https://alphadouro.com/sunset-porto/ | Private Charter: https://alphadouro.com/private-charter-porto/ | WhatsApp: +351 914 160 240 | Email: booking@alphadouro.com | Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/alphadouro/ | Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61596748540767

## Experiences & Transparent Pricing
- **7 Bridges of the Douro Cruise (2h):** €30 per guest. Unhurried journey beneath Porto's seven historic bridges with 10 engine-off minutes and Douro wine tasting included. Winter: 11:00 & 13:30 · Summer (Apr–Sep): 11:00, 14:00 & 16:30. Max. 10 guests.
- **Sunset & Atlantic Ocean Cruise (2h):** €60 per guest. Golden hour across Porto's bridges and out to Foz do Douro, with 10 engine-off minutes and Douro wine tasting included. Winter: 15:45–Sunset · Summer (Apr–Sep): 19:00–Sunset. Max. 10 guests.
- **Private Boat Charter & Executive Boardroom (1–10 guests):** Custom quote. Entire vessel reserved exclusively for proposals, families, VIP guests, or corporate off-sites with direct VAT invoicing.
- **VIP Gift Vouchers:** Valid 365 days (Winter & Summer), personalized digital pass or wax-sealed envelope.
